P3_risk_ladder.gap: Vendor reviewers (CodeRabbit, BugBot) don't have an availability invariant; their outage cascades silently into the vendor-waiver path which depends on Skeptic + /er + cross-model — but those are ALSO subject to outage.

key_finding: The repo has multiple accidental Tessl-P1 invariants (gate verdicts, evidence floor, vacuous detector) but they are NOT explicitly REGISTERED as invariants. The fact that 'false-PASS at 7/7' slipped through (MEMORY 2026-08-17) is direct evidence that the current invariant surface is opaque — operators couldn't see what was actually being checked. Tessl would propose: (a) an explicit invariants registry, (b) live availability telemetry for every reviewer, (c) a 'verified-by' column on every claim.
